notes_for_editor: Thin record: no source gives a build date, design, status, staffing, access or site-today description for this tower. Checked the cached NHLR and FFLOS Georgia listings (this tower is not on either) and ran two searches. Possible duplicate: the tnlandforms list also has 'Harris County Lookout Tower' (GA023, matched to us-ga-harris-county) a few hundred metres away; an editor should decide whether these are one structure. The tnlandforms page names an 'elevation' field with no unit, so the 1,166 figure is read as feet (record elevation_m 355.4). The same page says names for towers 73 and above are its author's own creation; this tower is GA196, so 'pine mtn' is not evidence of a historical name. Harris Tower and William Mountain Tower (1955) have no locations in any source, so they must not be linked to this record. A 2006 Savannah Morning News article on Georgia fire towers (archived copy) names no Harris or Echols County tower. Name collision: 'pine mtn' also appears in Polk County (GA120); the story says Harris County throughout.
